title: event listener as dynamicProp is added erroneously to instance's props

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Version
3.2.31

### Reproduction link
[sfc.vuejs.org/](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
open the console，click button

### What is expected?
click trigger once

### What is actually happening?
after update,click trigger twice

---
when event listener as dynamicProp on updateProps, it is added to the instance’s props and it can be implicit binded to other components again by "v-bind=$props". it maybe trigger the callback function multiple times.
